label: Rainfall
source: NASA GPM IMERG Final Run v07, monthly 0.1°, aggregated to 0.5°
citation: Huffman, G. J. et al. (2023). GPM IMERG Final Precipitation L3 1 month 0.1 degree x 0.1 degree V07. NASA GES DISC. doi:10.5067/GPM/IMERG/3B-MONTH/07
method: Mann-Kendall with bias-corrected AR(1) variance correction (Yue & Wang 2004; quadratic detrending), Theil-Sen slope, Benjamini-Hochberg FDR

significance.scale: Colour range set by Africa's confirmed trends (90th percentile); stronger changes elsewhere show at full colour.
